lessons.text: Every line in a spec's Edge Cases section needs an owning task in tasks.md - an edge case with no task assigned to it typically ships unimplemented and untested.
evidence: spec.md Edge Cases (whitespace-only duplicate name; update-path reuse of a deactivated service's name) - no owning task in tasks.md (planning)

lessons.key: ac_gap::a value object s own passing unit tests or a sibling handler exercising the identical call pattern do not substitute for a dedicated test on the specific handler or route that also calls it give every error producing call site its own asserting test at the layer the test coverage matrix promises for that route
lessons.text: A value object's own passing unit tests, or a sibling handler exercising the identical call pattern, do not substitute for a dedicated test on the specific handler or route that also calls it - give every error-producing call site its own asserting test at the layer the Test Coverage Matrix promises for that route.
evidence: update-service.handler.spec.ts (no case renaming a service to a name only a deactivated service holds, even though service.repository.spec.ts:85-94 proves the identical existsActiveByName call shape) (application-handlers)

inventory-items.controller.ts POST/PATCH/:externalId/adjustments (inventory:manage) - only the /replenishments route got a dedicated mechanic-403 e2e case (test/e2e/inventory-items.e2e.spec.ts:112-123); create/update/adjust and the read-routes-with-neither-permission branch (INV-01 AC9) rest on the same decorator with no route-specific case (application-handlers)

create-inventory-item.request.dto.ts:24 (@IsIn(['PART','SUPPLY'])) and replenish/adjust DTOs' @IsPositive quantity guard (INV-01 AC2, INV-02 AC4) - no test at any layer asserts the DTO-level 400 for an invalid kind or a zero/negative movement quantity over HTTP, though the identical global ValidationPipe mechanism is proven for other DTOs elsewhere in the codebase (application-handlers)

WOP-01 AC6 (404), WOP-01 AC10 and WOP-03 AC5 (422): the aggregate's unit tests at work-order.spec.ts:1035/1063/1255 plus the ErrorKind mapping are the only evidence; no e2e asserts the status on the withdrawals or returns route (e2e-routes)
